deadline.intake: Autumn (September) intake, application by 30 April, holders of foreign certificate

tuition.note: CHF 2,190 per semester for foreigners moving to Switzerland to study (from autumn 2025), x2

requirement.text: Applicants from outside EU/EFTA/UK may only be considered for the preparatory year (CMS) if their certificate meets strict grade criteria, otherwise they must pass the entrance exam; French B2 (C1 recommended) is required.
